x-lionel.scope: Documentation lookup only. Not a source of runtime behaviour, and no gate may depend on it: CI validates this repository with pyyaml, jsonschema and grpcio-tools, and that list is the whole contract.
x-lionel.egress: Library and package names, and the documentation queries you type, leave the machine and go to Context7's servers. Repository contents are not sent.
x-lionel.secrets: None. The hosted endpoint accepts an Authorization: Bearer key; the keyless stdio path is used deliberately, because the key buys rate limit rather than capability (ADR-0015).
